highlights.reason_zh: 监管文件首次把 Anthropic 的季度收入与长期算力负担放在同一口径下，改变供应商和基础设施风险判断。
highlights.reason_en: The regulatory filing puts Anthropic quarterly revenue and long-duration compute obligations on one basis, changing vendor and infrastructure risk judgments.

highlights.reason_zh: CUDA 基线与 serving 行为同时变化，直接影响自托管升级和回滚。
highlights.reason_en: CUDA baselines and serving behavior change together, directly affecting self-hosted upgrades and rollback.

highlights.reason_zh: 柔性用电已有一份获批合同，但实际削峰与费率结果仍未发生。
highlights.reason_en: Load flexibility now has one approved contract, while operational curtailment and rate effects remain unobserved.

highlights.reason_zh: 统一 workload 映射可减少平台适配，但采用与互操作仍主要由厂商证明。
highlights.reason_en: A common workload map can reduce platform adapters, but adoption and interoperability remain mainly vendor-supported.

highlights.reason_zh: 可复现审计否定了热门“模型泄露”，避免团队下载数 TB 假权重或运行不明代码。
highlights.reason_en: A reproducible audit rejects a viral model-leak claim, helping teams avoid terabytes of fake weights and untrusted code.

coverage_zh: 完成 36/36 个固定入口，并主动补查小团队、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料和重大综合新闻。召回自检补入一条 overlap 漏检；同日索引仍不完整，Anthropic 中期报表未经审计，基础设施效果与厂商采用仍待独立验证。
coverage_en: Completed all 36 fixed monitors plus active checks across small teams, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language sources and exceptional general news. Recall auditing recovered one overlap miss; same-day indexing remains incomplete, Anthropic interim statements are unaudited, and infrastructure effects plus vendor adoption still need independent validation.
